caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded clay jar with a slightly uneven rim, two looped handles positioned symmetrically on either side, and a tapered base. The surface of the jar is beige or sandy brown in color, with shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. On the body of the jar, there is a simple illustration of a fish, rendered with blue-gray lines and details. The interior of the jar near the opening is shaded in a darker reddish-brown. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, causing the jar to be prominently featured in the center of the image.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
